It is also important to understand what was used more in our dialog ("ты" or "вы") automatically using regexes or peg grammars or similar.

May be we can even use our rules or context discovery rules.

Not talking for long means at least 90 days not talking.

Also we need to make sure we have safe or debug mode, where we only pre-fill one message at a time and user sends it after confirmation.
title: We need to support ability to do messaging to all personal contacts we were not talking for long
